# `vl cloak`

Encrypt matching paths for a scope (default: team)

```text
vl cloak [OPTIONS] <PATTERNS>...
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<PATTERNS>…` | Paths or glob patterns (required) |

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `--scope <SCOPE>` | Scope to encrypt for (you must hold its key) (default: `team`) |
